verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox documents on-request open-and-scan of letter contents delivered as PDFs, which goes beyond an envelope photo. Nothing in the evidence states a scan turnaround time or says the PDFs are searchable. Missing for 10: a stated same/next-business-day scan turnaround, documentation that PDFs are searchable (OCR), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operator, my mail is opened and scanned to searchable PDFs with a stated turnaround — same or next business day — not just an envelope photo

citations.quote: you can request that the operator open and scan a letter's contents
where your mail is received, scanned, and uploaded to your account
